question: There are over _______ Lakh ODF Plus Villages in December 2024.
solution:
The correct answer is __**5.61 Lakh**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• As of **December 2024**, there are over **5.61 Lakh Open Defecation Free (ODF) Plus Villages** in India under the Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM) Grameen Phase-II. 
• The **Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM)**, launched in 2014, aims to eliminate open defecation and improve solid and liquid waste management across rural and urban areas of India. 
• The ODF Plus status is awarded to villages that have sustained their ODF status and have made progress in **solid and liquid waste management (SLWM)**. 
• Under ODF Plus, villages are categorized as **ODF Plus Aspiring, ODF Plus Rising, and ODF Plus Model**, depending on their progress in achieving sanitation and waste management goals.
